result.summary: The page renders cleanly with no clear visual breakage. Header, search bar, category chips, promo banner, carousels, list cards and bottom navigation are aligned and legible. Clipped carousel items and the partially visible pizza card are expected behavior and not reported. Only minor polish points were found.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows '€0 delivery' twice: once as a badge on the image and again in the metadata line below it.
issues.suggestion: Keep only one of them, or use the image badge for a different promotion, to reduce visual noise.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons look inconsistent. The dark circular backdrop is clearly visible on the pizza card but almost disappears on the dark ramen image.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent translucent backdrop (e.g., semi-transparent white or a blurred chip) so the button looks the same on any image.

issues.description: Metadata text weights are inconsistent. The ramen card's details line (time, delivery, cuisine) uses a heavier gray weight, while delivery fees in 'Fastest near you' use regular weight.
issues.suggestion: Standardize secondary metadata typography across card types.
